receiptProfileSpecification.name: VerifierReceiptProfile
receiptProfileSpecification.purpose: immutable assertion by CVF verifier after source-owned registry lookup

signedFields.name: domain
signedFields.description: fixed literal binding this preimage to this exact profile; never receipt-supplied at verification time, always the checker's own hard-coded literal

signedFields.name: profileVersion
signedFields.description: fixed literal for this specification version; a future v2 profile must use a different literal so cross-version signatures never verify

signedFields.name: verificationRound
signedFields.description: decision round identifier, immutable from lookup observation

signedFields.name: verificationAuthorityHash
signedFields.description: SHA-256 of authority specification at lookup time

signedFields.name: issuerIdentity
signedFields.description: claimed issuer identifier from registry query

signedFields.name: issuerAttestedHash
signedFields.description: issuer self-supplied hash binding their authority/policy

signedFields.name: trustedRegistrySnapshotIdentity
signedFields.description: registry snapshot identifier from source-owned observation log

signedFields.name: trustedRegistrySnapshotHash
signedFields.description: SHA-256 of source-owned registry state at lookup

signedFields.name: lookupResult
signedFields.description: verified admission status from registry lookup

signedFields.name: observationTimeUtc
signedFields.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when lookup was performed

signedFields.name: receiptIssuanceTimeUtc
signedFields.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when receipt was created

signedFields.name: signatureKeyId
signedFields.description: identifier selecting public key from trusted verifier registry

jcsCanonicaliation.preimageUse: Ed25519 signature input; never includes signedBy envelope

envelopeFields.name: signedBy
envelopeFields.description: signature and key metadata; not part of preimage

admissionPredicates.name: Content Integrity
admissionPredicates.purpose: verify receipt encoding is valid UTF-8, well-formed, and structurally sound
checks: no null or empty required fields
no unknown fields in preimage object
admissionPredicates.description: necessary but not sufficient; content validity without signature does not authenticate

admissionPredicates.name: Verifier Signature Validity
admissionPredicates.purpose: verify signature was created by verifier holding Ed25519 private key for keyId
checks: reconstruct JCS preimage from all fourteen signed fields using fixed domain and profileVersion literals
resolve exactly one record by exact keyId in source-owned trusted verifier registry; reject duplicate IDs and public-key aliases
verify key expiresAt (if set) > observationTimeUtc (equality is expired)
verify key role authorizes issuance for verificationAuthority
verify Ed25519 signature over reconstructed preimage using public key

failureCodes.KEY_ID_MISMATCH: signedBy.keyId does not equal signed signatureKeyId
failureCodes.KEY_AMBIGUOUS: duplicate keyId or public-key alias in trusted registry
failureCodes.REGISTRY_UNAVAILABLE: trusted registry lookup or ambiguity check unavailable
failureCodes.KEY_ROLE_UNAUTHORIZED: key role does not permit issuance
failureCodes.MALFORMED_KEY: public key is not valid Ed25519

admissionPredicates.typeScriptResponsibility: decision-time verification with async registry lookup
admissionPredicates.description: proves only that verifier authorized the preimage, not that lookup was genuine

admissionPredicates.name: Genuine Lookup Provenance
admissionPredicates.purpose: verify receipt binds source-owned registry observation and outcome matches registry state

callerSuppliedParameters.name: expectedCurrentRound
callerSuppliedParameters.description: decision owner's actual current round; never read from the receipt; receipt.verificationRound must equal this exactly or the check fails closed before any lookup runs

callerSuppliedParameters.name: expectedAuthorityHash
callerSuppliedParameters.description: SHA-256 of the trusted decision-owner authority specification; sourced independently of the receipt and required to match verificationAuthorityHash

callerSuppliedParameters.name: evaluationTimeUtc
callerSuppliedParameters.description: caller's current time at verification; never receipt-supplied

callerSuppliedParameters.name: freshnessThresholdSeconds
callerSuppliedParameters.description: caller-configured maximum allowed age between evaluationTimeUtc and observation.observedAt

checks: verify receipt.verificationRound == expectedCurrentRound (round binding, checked first)
verify receipt.verificationAuthorityHash == caller-supplied expectedAuthorityHash; unavailable trusted context fails closed
verify freshnessThresholdSeconds is nonnegative and timestamps are valid RFC 3339 values
look up trustedRegistrySnapshotIdentity in source-owned observation log
verify receipt.observationTimeUtc <= receipt.receiptIssuanceTimeUtc <= evaluationTimeUtc and observation.observedAt <= evaluationTimeUtc
verify source-owned observation log has exactly one observation for trustedRegistrySnapshotIdentity
perform issuer lookup in source registry using issuerIdentity AND issuerAttestedHash against snapshot content; a mismatched hash cannot yield IDENTITY_CONFIRMED
verify recomputed result matches receipt.lookupResult exactly

failureCodes.ROUND_MISMATCH: receipt.verificationRound does not equal the caller's expectedCurrentRound
failureCodes.AUTHORITY_HASH_MISMATCH: receipt.verificationAuthorityHash differs from the independently trusted expectedAuthorityHash or trusted context is unavailable
failureCodes.INVALID_VERIFICATION_CONTEXT: negative freshness threshold or malformed timestamp
failureCodes.SNAPSHOT_NOT_IN_LOG: trustedRegistrySnapshotIdentity not in source observation log
failureCodes.SNAPSHOT_HASH_MISMATCH: observation snapshot hash does not match trustedRegistrySnapshotHash
failureCodes.INVALID_TIME_ORDER: lookup time after receipt issuance, receipt issuance after evaluation time, or observation in the future
failureCodes.FORKED_OBSERVATION: more than one source-owned observation exists for this snapshot identity
failureCodes.LOOKUP_RESULT_MISMATCH: recomputed lookup result does not match receipt.lookupResult

admissionPredicates.typeScriptResponsibility: decision-time lookup with source registry and observation log clients, using caller-supplied expectedCurrentRound/expectedAuthorityHash/evaluationTimeUtc/freshnessThresholdSeconds
admissionPredicates.pythonResponsibility: persisted-evidence verification using static snapshots and the same four caller-supplied parameters
admissionPredicates.description: independent verification that lookup was performed by source authority, bound to receipt, current round, and fresh; VERIFIED here proves lookupResult genuinely matches registry state, not that the identity was confirmed (see admissionOutcomeBinding)

admissionOutcomeBinding.name: Admission Outcome Binding
admissionOutcomeBinding.purpose: separates receipt authenticity (all three predicates pass) from actual admission (the confirmed outcome), so an authentic non-confirming receipt is never treated as admitted

outcomeFields.verified: true iff all three predicates independently passed; the receipt is authentic
outcomeFields.admitted: true iff verified AND lookupResult is exactly IDENTITY_CONFIRMED; this is the field callers must gate on, never verified alone

admissionOutcomeBinding.regressionThisClosed: a prior revision returned verified=true as the sole admission signal, so an authentic, provenance-matched receipt whose lookupResult was IDENTITY_REJECTED (AV-11) was indistinguishable in outcome from a genuinely confirmed receipt (AV-0); this field split and explicit equality check close that gap

admissionRule.name: Three-Predicate Conjunctive Admission Plus Outcome Binding
admissionRule.logic: Receipt is VERIFIED if and only if all three predicates independently return VERIFIED; receipt is ADMITTED if and only if VERIFIED and lookupResult == IDENTITY_CONFIRMED
admissionRule.shortCircuit: any predicate failure immediately returns UNVERIFIED; remaining predicates not evaluated

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Genuine Confirmed Identity (Positive Control)
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: published preimage/signature verifies; hypothetical trusted context supplies matching round and authority hash, and a fresh singly-observed source snapshot confirms issuer-test-001 with its attested hash. No real registry provenance is supplied by the cryptographic fixture
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate3: VERIFIED only under the stated hypothetical source-owned snapshot and trusted-context assumptions
adversarialVectorMatrix.keyInsight: sole positive-path vector; every other vector must resolve to admitted=false

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Forged Content Hash (Self-Authored)
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: attacker constructs valid receipt fields with no signature

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Signature Under Receipt-Supplied Key
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: receipt includes supplemental public key; signature valid under that key
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate2: FAIL (key registry lookup fails; receipt-supplied key rejected before verification)

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Valid Signature Under Revoked Key
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: receipt signed with key revoked before receipt issuance; signature is cryptographically valid
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate2: FAIL (key registry check detects revokedAt <= receiptIssuanceTimeUtc)
adversarialVectorMatrix.keyInsight: key lifecycle check prevents use of revoked keys

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Modified Signature keyId
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: attacker modifies signatureKeyId to point to different key; signature corresponds to original key
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate2: FAIL (envelope/preimage key-ID mismatch fails before lookup; if both IDs change, Ed25519 verification fails; aliases fail closed)
adversarialVectorMatrix.keyInsight: keyId equality and registry uniqueness precede cryptographic verification

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Fabricated Lookup Result
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: valid signature and snapshot hash; but actual registry at snapshot lacks issuer or shows negative result
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate3: FAIL (recomputed lookup result does not match receipt.lookupResult)
adversarialVectorMatrix.keyInsight: receipt and registry state must be independently verified to match

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Stale Registry Snapshot
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: receipt references old registry snapshot; observedAt is older than freshnessThresholdSeconds relative to evaluationTimeUtc
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate3: FAIL ((evaluationTimeUtc - observation.observedAt) exceeds freshnessThresholdSeconds; explicit algorithm step, see LookupProvenanceCheck)
adversarialVectorMatrix.keyInsight: explicit caller-supplied freshness threshold, computed against caller's evaluationTimeUtc, prevents use of outdated registry state

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Forked Observation Chain
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: two receipts for same issuer in same round; each binds different snapshot identity; only one snapshot identity has a source-owned observation, and that observation log entry is singular (not itself forked); authoritative receipt's lookupResult is IDENTITY_CONFIRMED
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate3: VERIFIED for authoritative; FAIL for forked (snapshot not in source log)
adversarialVectorMatrix.verifiedResult: true for authoritative; false for forked
adversarialVectorMatrix.admittedResult: true for authoritative (lookupResult=IDENTITY_CONFIRMED); false for forked
adversarialVectorMatrix.admissionResult: VERIFIED_AND_ADMITTED for authoritative; UNVERIFIED for forked
adversarialVectorMatrix.keyInsight: forked receipts detected by checking against single authoritative observation source; a single observation-log entry that itself has more than one record for the same snapshot identity separately fails with FORKED_OBSERVATION

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Cross-Round Receipt Replay
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: receipt from round N replayed when the caller's expectedCurrentRound is N+1; verificationRound field unchanged at N
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate3: FAIL, deterministically (receipt.verificationRound != expectedCurrentRound is the first check in LookupProvenanceCheck, evaluated before any snapshot/authority/lookup step)
adversarialVectorMatrix.keyInsight: round binding against the caller's own current round is unconditional and checked first, not a conditional or registry-state-dependent outcome

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Invalid JCS Canonicalization
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: receipt preimage uses non-RFC8785 canonicalization; signature was computed over different preimage
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate2: FAIL (recomputed preimage does not match signed bytes; Ed25519 verification fails)
adversarialVectorMatrix.keyInsight: strict RFC 8785 canonicalization prevents encoding-based signature bypass

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Unavailable Verifier Registry
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: receipt otherwise valid; verifier registry inaccessible (network, deletion, etc.); signatureKeyId cannot be resolved
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate2: FAIL (registry unavailable; key cannot be retrieved; fail-closed)
adversarialVectorMatrix.keyInsight: system fails closed until registry is available; no fallback acceptance

adversarialVectorMatrix.name: Authentic Receipt, Genuinely Rejected Identity
adversarialVectorMatrix.setup: same preimage shape, signing key and hypothetical snapshot as AV-0 but a different issuer (issuer-test-rejected-002); the hypothetical source lookup rejects that issuer and attested hash; published bytes alone prove signature consistency, not source-owned provenance; see negativeTestVector
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate2: PASS (independently reconstructed and verified under the same key as AV-0)
adversarialVectorMatrix.predicate3: VERIFIED only under the stated hypothetical source-owned snapshot and trusted-context assumptions; not proved by the cryptographic fixture alone
adversarialVectorMatrix.keyInsight: this is the vector a three-predicate-only design (without a separate admissionOutcomeBinding check) would incorrectly admit, since all three predicates pass identically to AV-0; only the explicit lookupResult==IDENTITY_CONFIRMED check at admission time distinguishes AV-0 from AV-11

positiveTestVector.note: computed with a deterministic test-fixture Ed25519 keypair (seed SHA-256("CVF-T2C-POSITIVE-VECTOR-TEST-FIXTURE-SEED-0001")); proves cryptographic consistency only. No source-owned snapshot, observation log, trusted authority specification or operational key is supplied; Predicate 3 and admission are hypothetical conditional illustrations
positiveTestVector.independentReconstructionResult: PASS: decoding publicKeyBase64Url and signatureBase64Url and calling Ed25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes(...).verify(signature_bytes, preimage_bytes) against preimageBytesCompactJcs succeeds using only these published strings

negativeTestVector.note: same test-fixture key and hypothetical snapshot as positiveTestVector, but a different issuer, receiptId and lookupResult; cryptographic validity alone does not imply admission and no real source-owned provenance is proved
negativeTestVector.independentReconstructionResult: PASS: signature independently verifies exactly like positiveTestVector, proving Predicate 2 passes; admission is still correctly denied by admissionOutcomeBinding because lookupResult != IDENTITY_CONFIRMED
